name: bit-native
description: The Rust `bit` CLI. `pnpm install` installs the Rust toolchain rust-toolchain.toml names and the crates; see ../docs/rust-cli.md.

scripts.build: pnpm run prepare-engine && cargo build --locked --release -p bit-cli
scripts.build:debug: pnpm run prepare-engine && cargo build --locked -p bit-cli
scripts.lint: pnpm run prepare-engine && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
